CP-200 Centrifugal Pump Operating and Maintenance Manual › 7 Maintenance › 7.2 Service intervals
## 7.2 Service intervals
Inspect the mechanical seal and the bearings every 2,000 operating hours or six months, whichever comes first.
Replace mechanical seal PN-4471-B every 8,000 operating hours.
| Task | Interval |
|---|---|
| Inspect the mechanical seal and the bearings | 2,000 h or 6 months |
| Regrease the bearings (lithium-complex grease, 15 g per bearing) | 4,000 h |
| Check the coupling alignment | 12 months |
| Replace mechanical seal PN-4471-B | 8,000 h |
| Replace the bearings | 32,000 h |
Record every inspection in the maintenance log with the operating hours from the hour meter.

SOP-FS-014: Mechanical seal replacement on CP-200 pumps
# SOP-FS-014: Mechanical seal replacement on CP-200 pumps
1. Apply lockout/tagout to the motor and isolate the seal-water and process lines, as safety bulletin SB-0932 requires.
Verify zero energy.
3. Remove the seal housing and the old seal.
Inspect the shaft sleeve for scoring.
4. Fit mechanical seal PN-4471-C.
7. Record the seal's part number and the operating hours in the work order.

## Removing the old seal
- Remove the seal housing and the old seal
- Inspect the shaft sleeve for scoring

CP-200 Centrifugal Pump Operating and Maintenance Manual › 8 Spare parts › 8.1 Mechanical seal and recommended spares
## 8.1 Mechanical seal and recommended spares
The CP-200 uses cartridge mechanical seal PN-4471-B, supplied by Fabrikam Seals.
Keep the spares in Table 8-1 at every site that runs CP-200 pumps.
| Mechanical seal | PN-4471-B | 1 |
| Ball bearing, pump end | PN-3310-A | 1 |
| Ball bearing, drive end | PN-3311-A | 1 |
